description: Read a named destination's travel guides: weather, getting here, transport, entry requirements, safety and more. Pass topic (from destination_overview guide_topics) to read one subject; page with cursor.

cursor.description: Number of items to skip; pass `next_cursor` from the previous page.

destination.description: Destination name or slug, e.g. 'Los Cabos'; list_cities names them.

limit.description: Entries per page; omit for the server's short default.

query.description: Text to match in guide title/body.

name: destination_guide

outputSchema.description: The Yenta response envelope: a status, the answer in `item` or `items`, and the approved content revision it was read from.

title: Destination guides by name
